cards.title: Play School Returns: Quality TV for Toddlers
cards.body: This beloved children's program offers a refreshing alternative to overstimulating modern shows designed to grab attention like smartphones do. Parents can feel confident letting their toddlers watch content that prioritizes genuine learning and calm engagement.

cards.title: Working Parents: School Holidays Need Better Planning
cards.body: The school day ending at 3pm creates a logistical nightmare for working parents juggling childcare and full-time jobs. More flexible approaches to school holidays could transform them from stressful admin challenges into quality family time.

cards.title: Why New Moms Need Real Support, Not Just Chat
cards.body: New mothers can feel isolated despite constant contact with their babies, and research shows different types of social connection directly impact emotional wellbeing. Moving beyond group chats to meaningful in-person support is crucial for maternal mental health.

cards.title: Parental Guilt Doesn't Make Better Parents
cards.body: Parents experience guilt more than 20 times weekly, but understanding your emotions is more effective than acting on guilt alone. Learning to evaluate guilt before responding helps develop genuine parenting strength.

cards.title: Protecting Children From Parental Burnout Effects
cards.body: Parenting becomes significantly harder without adequate support and relief, directly impacting child wellbeing. Understanding burnout's effects on children helps parents recognize when to seek help.

cards.title: Understanding Your Relationship With Your Mother
cards.body: Our primary relationship with our mother shapes how we understand ourselves and form other relationships. This foundational bond frequently emerges in therapy as central to personal development.
